description: An unbleached linen thread used to sew the sections of a book together and to the supports; its weight is chosen to suit the paper so the swelling at the back stays even.
name: sewing thread

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter VII, p.98. Internet Archive.
